question: Will the IOM Missing Migrants Project record at least 1,000 Mediterranean migrant deaths in 2026 before May 2026?
summary: Early 2026 mortality pace (~606 by end-February) raises the possibility of reaching 1,000 by end-April if momentum persists.
Threshold requires ~394 additional deaths in Mar–Apr; this pace is plausible but uncertain given monthly volatility.
Adverse weather and storm conditions could increase fatalities in the near term, supporting the higher bound.
Reporting gaps and data lags may undercount fatalities, biasing observed totals downward.
No published near-term forecast models; reliance on early-year trend introduces additional uncertainty.
